svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 04 / TETRIS
svg.desc: 13,956 GitHub contributions across 138 active days, 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-14. Active dates supply legal tetrominoes, with lower contribution counts first. The board has the original calendar width and seven weekday rows. Missing dates are unavailable. Pieces collide with the stack, full weekday lines clear, and the permanent date colors remain fixed beneath the piece outlines. If no legal piece fits, the calendar rests.

g.text: 138 planned date pieces · 0 restarts · 0 without drop space
Original date colors stay fixed beneath the stack.
